nodes.label: Lean-mass loss during rapid weight loss
AASLD (American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases)
ATTAIN-1
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity without diabetes, 72 wk
nodes.outcome: Highest-dose arm -11.2% vs -2.1% placebo (treatment-regimen); AE discontinuation 5.3-10.3% vs 2.7%

nodes.label: ATTAIN-2
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity/overweight + T2D, 72 wk
nodes.outcome: Placebo-subtracted weight up to -7.1%; HbA1c up to -1.1 pp; AE discontinuation 6.1-9.9% vs 4.1%

nodes.label: ATTAIN-J
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, Japanese participants with obesity disease

nodes.label: ACHIEVE-3
nodes.design: Phase 3 open-label non-inferiority vs oral semaglutide, T2D

nodes.label: TRIUMPH-1
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity without diabetes, 80 wk

nodes.label: TRIUMPH-1-OSA substudy
nodes.design: Phase 3 substudy, OSA, 80 wk
nodes.outcome: AHI -34.3 / -31.7 vs -9.9 events/h (hybrid estimand)

nodes.label: TRIUMPH-3
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, severe obesity + established CVD
nodes.outcome: -21.6% to -22.6% vs -3.2%; AE discontinuation 9.8%/13.5% vs 4.8%; MACE lower than anticipated in both arms (sponsor topline)

nodes.label: TRIUMPH-4
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity + knee osteoarthritis, 68 wk
nodes.outcome: Weight up to -28.7%; WOMAC pain -75.8%; AE discontinuation 12.2%/18.2% vs 4.0% (sponsor topline)

nodes.label: REDEFINE 1
nodes.design: Phase 3a RCT, overweight/obesity without diabetes, 68 wk
nodes.outcome: -20.4% vs -3.0% placebo (diff -17.3 pp, 95% CI -18.1 to -16.6); 22.7% on full-adherence estimand

nodes.label: REDEFINE 2
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, type 2 diabetes, 68 wk
nodes.outcome: -13.7% vs -3.1% placebo (sponsor)

nodes.label: REDEFINE 4
nodes.design: Phase 3 head-to-head vs tirzepatide, 84 wk
nodes.outcome: MISSED primary endpoint of non-inferiority on weight loss (sponsor)

nodes.label: MariTide phase 2
nodes.design: Phase 2 dose-ranging RCT, 52 wk, two cohorts
nodes.outcome: Obesity cohort ~-12% to -16% vs ~-2.5%; T2D cohort ~-8% to -12% vs ~-1.7%; gallbladder events 1-6% vs 0%; no plateau at 52 wk

nodes.label: ZUPREME-1
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, overweight/obesity, 42 wk
nodes.outcome: Top arm -10.7% vs -1.7%; nausea 19.6% vs 6.2%; dropouts 8.4% vs 13.6% placebo; vomiting less frequent than placebo (sponsor)

nodes.label: ZUPREME-2
nodes.design: Phase 2b RCT, obesity + T2D, 28 wk
nodes.outcome: Up to -9.2% weight loss; primary met (sponsor)

nodes.label: SYNCHRONIZE-1
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, overweight/obesity without diabetes, 76 wk
nodes.outcome: Up to -16.6% vs -3.2%; co-primaries met on both estimands (sponsor)

nodes.label: SYNCHRONIZE-2
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity + T2D, 76 wk
nodes.outcome: Up to -13.1% vs -3.1%; HbA1c up to -1.21 pp (sponsor)

nodes.label: SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, obesity with MASLD
nodes.outcome: Co-primaries met both estimands; up to 84.2% achieved >=30% relative liver-fat reduction

nodes.label: Survodutide MASH phase 2
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, MASH, 48 wk
nodes.outcome: MASH improvement without fibrosis worsening 47% / 62% / 43% vs 22% placebo; non-monotonic dose response

nodes.label: LIVERAGE
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, MASH F2-F3, 52 wk
nodes.outcome: Enrolling; no results

nodes.label: LIVERAGE-Cirrhosis
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, compensated MASH cirrhosis
nodes.outcome: Enrolling; primary completion ~2029

nodes.label: GLORY-1
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, Chinese adults with overweight/obesity, 48 wk
nodes.outcome: ~-11.0% / -14.0% vs +0.3% placebo; AE discontinuation 1.5%/0.5% vs 1.0%

nodes.label: Amycretin phase 2 (T2D)
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, type 2 diabetes, 36 wk
nodes.outcome: Subcutaneous up to -14.5/-14.6%; oral up to -10.1%; HbA1c up to -1.5 pp (sponsor)

nodes.label: SELECT
nodes.design: Phase 3 CV outcomes RCT, overweight/obesity + established CVD, no diabetes
nodes.outcome: Primary MACE composite 6.5% vs 8.0%, HR 0.80

nodes.label: FLOW
nodes.design: Phase 3 kidney outcomes RCT, T2D + CKD
nodes.outcome: Primary kidney composite -24%; kidney-specific HR 0.79; CV death HR 0.71; eGFR slope +1.16 mL/min/1.73m2/yr

nodes.label: Pooled kidney analysis (SELECT, FLOW, SOUL)
nodes.design: Prespecified pooled analysis
nodes.outcome: Primary kidney composite HR 0.84; secondary composite HR 0.80

nodes.label: ESSENCE
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, non-cirrhotic MASH F2-F3, 72 wk interim
nodes.outcome: MASH resolution without fibrosis worsening 62.9% vs 34.3%; >=1-stage fibrosis improvement 36.8% vs 22.4%; weight -10.5% vs -2.0%

nodes.label: SURMOUNT-OSA
nodes.design: Two phase 3 RCTs, moderate-severe OSA without T2D, 52 wk
nodes.outcome: Weight -17.7% (non-PAP) and -19.6% (PAP); basis of first FDA OSA approval

nodes.label: EVOKE / EVOKE+
nodes.design: Two phase 3 RCTs, early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, 104 wk
nodes.outcome: NEGATIVE: no significant slowing on CDR-SB; pooled analysis no delay to dementia through wk 156; biomarkers moved without clinical benefit

nodes.label: Oral semaglutide for alcohol use disorder
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, treatment-seeking moderate-severe AUD, 8 wk
nodes.outcome: Mixed: no significant effect on lab craving or drinks/day; reduced heavy drinking days, drinks per drinking day, naturalistic craving, cannabis-use days

nodes.label: Once-weekly semaglutide in AUD
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, non-treatment-seeking adults
nodes.outcome: Reduced alcohol consumed in post-treatment lab self-administration task

nodes.label: CRAVE
nodes.design: RCT, US veterans with moderate-severe AUD
nodes.outcome: Planned; no results

nodes.label: BELIEVE
nodes.design: Phase 2b RCT, obesity without diabetes, bimagrumab +/- semaglutide, 48-72 wk
nodes.outcome: Weight -22.1% (combo) vs -15.7% (sema) vs -10.8% (bima); lean mass -2.9% vs -7.4%, bima alone +2.5%; acne and muscle spasms

nodes.label: EMBRAZE
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, apitegromab + tirzepatide, 24 wk
nodes.outcome: +1.9 kg lean mass retained = 54.9% preservation (p=0.001); weight -12.3% vs -13.4%; SAEs balanced

nodes.label: COURAGE
nodes.design: Phase 2 RCT, trevogrumab +/- garetosmab with semaglutide, 26-52 wk
nodes.outcome: Lean-mass preservation 42.5% / 20.5% vs placebo+sema at 52 wk; MRI substudy 70% of muscle loss prevented; higher-dose arms increased lean mass during rebound regain (sponsor)

nodes.label: QUALITY
nodes.design: Phase 2b RCT, enobosarm + semaglutide, older adults with obesity, 16 wk
nodes.outcome: 71% relative reduction in lean-mass loss; similar total weight loss; regain cut ~46% in extension; more liver enzyme elevations (sponsor, not peer-reviewed)

nodes.label: COMP005
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, treatment-resistant depression, single dose
nodes.outcome: Met primary: greater MADRS reduction at wk 6; TEAE 84.8% vs 59.8% placebo through wk 26 (sponsor)

nodes.label: COMP006
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, treatment-resistant depression, 26 wk
nodes.outcome: Met primary endpoint; durability figures post hoc; remission rates not disclosed (sponsor)

nodes.label: MMED008 (MM120 phase 2b)
nodes.design: Phase 2b RCT, generalized anxiety disorder, 22 US sites
nodes.outcome: Significant dose-response on HAM-A at wk 4; AEs mostly mild-moderate and confined to dosing day

nodes.label: Voyage
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, generalized anxiety disorder
nodes.outcome: Positive topline (sponsor)

nodes.label: Panorama
nodes.design: Phase 3 RCT, generalized anxiety disorder
nodes.outcome: Met primary: significant improvement in HAM-A total score at wk 12 (sponsor)

nodes.label: TRD4005
nodes.design: Phase 4 RCT, treatment-resistant depression, 4 wk
nodes.outcome: Remission at day 28: 22.5% vs 7.6% placebo; basis of monotherapy approval

nodes.label: TAZPOWER
nodes.design: RCT crossover + open-label extension, Barth syndrome
nodes.outcome: Randomised primary endpoints missed; OLE improvements; basis of accelerated approval

nodes.label: SPIBA-401 / 4TAZPower
nodes.design: Phase 3b/4 RCT, Barth syndrome, FDA-required confirmatory trial
nodes.outcome: Registered; actual enrolment start unverified

nodes.outcome: Recruiting from 2026-02; enrolment target varies by source

nodes.outcome: TERMINATED (sponsor decision)
